evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of
early heart disease.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 88 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 155 ms, QRS 83 ms, QTc 459 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.
Most recent echo showed an ejection fraction of 55%.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estiated at
30%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Severely reduced left ventricular systolic function.
